description: A practical operator resource for people who run catering businesses: licensing, pricing, contracts, software, and certifications.
tagline: The operator's guide to running a catering business.
image_alt: Institute of Catering — resources for catering business owners.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: The Institute of Catering editorial team.

editorial.testing: All resources, templates, and guides are vetted by current or former catering operators. We review local regulations regularly but do not provide legal advice.
editorial.monetization: We fund this site through software referrals and certification affiliate programs. We only recommend tools we have tested or used in production. Commission links are marked with rel="sponsored nofollow" and disclosed above the fold.
editorial.corrections: We correct factual errors promptly. If you spot an inaccuracy in licensing requirements or pricing models, please contact us.
